overview: Add a DestinationSafetyPolicy that runs in LinkService.create after the existing syntactic UrlValidator. It refuses (1) hosts equal to or under a configured blocked domain, matched on label boundaries, (2) IP-literal hosts including IPv6 and numeric/hex encodings that bypass naive checks, and (3) URLs with user info, which disguise the real host (https://bank.example@evil.test). Refusals raise UnsafeDestinationException, mapped to 422 urn:problem:unsafe-destination with a reason that never echoes the URL. Settings come from a new SafetyProperties record (shortener.safety.*) so operators can update the blocklist without code changes.

components.name: Create path integration
components.responsibility: Invoke the policy and map the error

decisions.decision: Separate policy class instead of extending UrlValidator
decisions.rationale: Syntax and safety change for different reasons and have different configuration

decisions.decision: Match blocked domains on label boundaries
Treat all-numeric and hex hosts as IP literals
decisions.rationale: http://3232235521/ and http://0xC0A80001/ are IP addresses in disguise
The request is well formed; the destination is refused by policy

decisions.decision: Never echo the URL in errors or logs
decisions.rationale: User info may contain real credentials

alternatives.whyNotChosen: Stakeholder chose rejection at creation; interstitial changes the redirect path and needs UI
Adds a network dependency and latency to create; deferred until a provider is chosen

risks.description: Blocklist goes stale and misses new phishing domains
risks.mitigation: Configurable list; follow-up to integrate a reputation feed
Label-boundary matching and tests for lookalike suffixes

risks.description: Credentials from rejected URLs leak into logs
risks.mitigation: No logging of rejected URLs; generic error messages

testStrategy: Unit-test DestinationSafetyPolicy across blocked domains, subdomains, lookalike suffixes, case and trailing dots, IPv4/IPv6/decimal/hex hosts, credentials and the toggle for IP literals. Integration-test POST /api/v1/links for 422 responses and that normal URLs still return 201. The existing suite proves no regression.
rollbackPlan: Revert the commit, or set shortener.safety.blocked-domains to an empty list and block-ip-literals to false to disable the checks without a deploy of new code.
